private_lines.Maya: You work nights as a paramedic out of the Seacroft station, so this week you're juggling three twelve-hour shifts and trying to sleep in the daytime with blackout curtains you keep forgetting to close.
private_lines.Tom: You're a sous chef at a busy Headingley bistro, and this week you're short-staffed after a colleague left, so you're covering prep and running the late shifts while planning your sister's birthday dinner on your one day off.
private_lines.Jo: You're a secondary school geography teacher in Chapel Allerton, and you're marking a stack of Year 10 coursework while preparing for parents' evening on Thursday.
private_lines.Sam: You work at the council planning office in Leeds city centre, and this week you're reviewing a contentious application for a block of flats near the canal, which keeps you at your desk later than you'd like.
private_lines.Priya: You're a pharmacist at a community chemist in Armley, and this week you're training two new dispensers while coordinating a flu vaccination clinic that's already fully booked.
private_lines.Dan: You run a small bike repair shop under the railway arches in Holbeck, and this week you're rebuilding a vintage tandem for a customer who wants it ready for a charity ride on Sunday.

setting: You all live in Leeds and met at the same university halls in your first year, and you've stayed close since, meeting up in the same pubs and flats ever since.
